expected.why: One question in two messages; one look, one answer.

events.text: how do I rotate the vault token?
for staging I mean

Use the Vault token’s accessor to revoke it, then create a replacement with the same policies and update the consuming secret/config before restarting workloads.

```bash
vault token lookup
vault token create -policy=<policy> -ttl=<duration>
# update the deployment/secret with the new token
vault token revoke <old-token-or-accessor>
```

For AppRole/Kubernetes auth, rotate the underlying SecretID or auth role credentials instead of using a long-lived token.
